sloka: पर्वत प्रभवा नद्यः सुभीम बहु निष्कुटाः ।मार्गितव्या दरीमन्तः पर्वताः च वनानि च ॥४-४०-३५॥
transliteration: parvata prabhavā nadyaḥ subhīma bahu niṣkuṭāḥ ।mārgitavyā darīmantaḥ parvatāḥ ca vanāni ca ॥4-40-35॥

translations.english: 'Then you may continue your search in the frightening islands of the sea as well as the sea which roars when stirred up by the wind.
